findings.issue: The flash is hidden by deferring close() a tick with setTimeout(..., 0); the open state still lives in two components.

harden.why: Zero-delay timers keep being used to hide one-frame ordering bugs.

candidate_rule.rule: Zero-delay timer used to paper over an ordering bug
candidate_rule.fix: Do not add a timer here. The flash means two pieces of state disagree for one frame: keep the value in one place and have the other read it.

summary: Masking: the timer hides the flash instead of fixing the duplicated open state. Request changes.
